diagnosis.headline: The payment container has stopped (it exited with code 137, OOMKilled=false, about 187s before the check). Checkout's PaymentService/Charge calls now fail with DNS 'server misbehaving' and 'no route to host' errors, so checkouts fail and email gets no traffic.

root_causes.cause: The payment container was killed with exit code 137 (SIGKILL; OOMKilled=false, so not a memory kill). It stopped at 05:23:37Z and has not restarted (restart_count 0). Its DNS name no longer resolves and its old IP 172.21.0.16:50051 gives 'no route to host', so every Charge call from checkout fails.

affected_services.impact: Container exited (code 137) and is unhealthy. It sends no spans, which is why it alerted as silent.
Its server error rate is 0.625 (baseline 0.0) because every PaymentService/Charge call fails, so orders cannot complete.
Checkout errors reach users: error_rate 0.0186 (baseline 0.0) on checkout flows.
Few or no confirmation emails go out because orders fail at payment, before checkout calls email. rps is 0.009 vs baseline 0.057.

anomalies.observed: exited, exit code 137, stopped 187s ago, health unhealthy

ruled_out.reason: The container is healthy and running. Its errors come from failed calls to payment, and its calls to shipping, cart and product-catalog succeed.
The container is healthy. Its traffic dropped because checkouts fail at payment before checkout calls email.

Memory is at 94.97% of its limit, but it is running and healthy. All its error traces start at checkout->payment. Its request rate was already about 2.4 rps at the start of the 30m window, so the drop against baseline is not part of this incident.
Flagged only for low traffic. Its server spans are fast (avg 7.8ms) and show no errors.

open_questions: What killed payment with exit 137 when OOMKilled=false? Check docker events and the host's audit logs.
A dry-run restart of payment appears in our action history at 04:09:14. Has payment failed repeatedly today?
frontend memory is at 94.97% of its 250MB limit. Watch it for a possible leak, separately from this incident.
prevention: Add a restart policy (restart: unless-stopped/on-failure) to the payment service in docker-compose so a killed container recovers on its own.
Alert on payment container state and exit codes, not only on silent spans downstream.
Add retry with backoff and a clear user-facing error in checkout when payment cannot be reached.
Find out what sent SIGKILL (exit 137 without OOM): a manual docker kill/stop, the host, or a chaos tool.

proposed_action.reason: The root cause is that the payment container stopped (exit 137). Restarting it brings back the gRPC endpoint and its DNS entry, so checkout can charge again.
proposed_action.risk_assessment: Low. payment is already down, so a restart cannot make things worse. If something outside the container is killing it, it could stop again. Watch the container state after the restart.
proposed_action.expected_outcome: payment sends spans again. Checkout error_rate falls from 0.625 to about 0.0, and email rps climbs back toward the 0.057 baseline within a few minutes.
